# Carbon parity

<!-- Generated by tool/carbon_parity.py. Review tool/carbon_parity.json. -->

Reviewed against Carbon `v11.118.0` (`44f90d8d6b24889af06cee1422ceb37f58e40bed`).
All 125 component modules reached by value exports in the React entrypoint are classified, including preview/unstable modules and explicit skeleton modules. Type-only prop exports are not components. Aliases share the decision for their source module; nested item/section wrappers are described as compositions.

**Present** describes the released family contract, not every React prop or wrapper. **Consolidated** names the Flutter composition/option replacing separate React components. **Partial** identifies a remaining behavior and its implementation issue. **Deferred** is unimplemented release scope; **Out of scope** describes an intentional platform/architecture boundary.

Fidelity tiers identify the strongest reviewed evidence for the named family: curated default-story comparison, Linux golden regression baseline, or behavior contract. A curated story does not establish all-variant or pixel-perfect parity. Golden-locked means comparison against the port baseline, not an independent upstream image. Deferred/platform-only rows have no implementation claim.

## Boundaries beyond the React entrypoint

- The newer compound PageHeader source exists in core but its v11 entrypoint export is deferred to v12. Carbide retains constructor composition and historical band geometry, with responsive action/tag disclosure, truncated-title help and a caller-owned hero slot. Sticky scroll/collapse orchestration is deferred.
- CSS subgrid/FlexGrid internals are outside the Wrap-based grid architecture; CarbonGrid/CarbonColumn provide breakpoints, margins, gutters, spans and column hang in Flutter composition.
- Next-major tile defaults and structured-list visible icons are deferred together under [ADR 0002](adr/0002-carbon-v12-feature-flag-posture.md). Current v11 controls remain implemented.
- Carbon Charts is a separate package/scope decision tracked in [M19 / #357](https://github.com/sunderee/carbide/issues/357). The 0.5.0 pass makes no Charts implementation or fidelity claim.

On a Carbon bump, re-review every changed component module, update the policy snapshot and equivalents, and run `python3 tool/carbon_parity.py --check-upstream` with the reference checked out. The Carbon reference workflow verifies the snapshot; normal CI checks the pinned review and rendered matrix offline.
